steps.goal: Open IK Handle Tool settings and set solver to Rotate Plane
common_mistakes: Building the limb as a perfectly straight chain makes the IK solver pick the bend direction unpredictably, so the knee or elbow can flip. (community: Autodesk Community: Arm bending wrong way | community: Polycount: IK joints need a slight bend / straight chain problem)
assumptions: Before this: A joint chain with a slight bend at the knee or elbow, oriented consistently.
Before this: Know the start joint (hip) and the end joint (ankle) of the limb.
steps.result: IK Handle Tool configured to use ikRPsolver.
